title.narrative: Address malnutrition through integrated multi-sector approach to drought affected communities in Bidu woreda in Afar regional State.

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project is designed in response to the dire needs in Afar regional state of Ethiopia aiming to address malnutrition through integrated multi-sector approach in drought affected hot spot woreda, Bidu. The key sectors included in this project are Nutrition, Agriculture, WASH and Health with meaningful protection mainstreaming. The project will address the prior needs of 17074 men, 18242 women, 14819 boys and 14556 girls.ltbrgtWorld Vision conducted an independent rapid assessment in April 2024 that revealed the severe impact of droughts, flood, past conflicts, crop pest disease outbreaks and cholera on specific woredas. Bidu is facing a crisis characterized by food insecurity manifested by high prevalence of malnutrition among children and pregnant and locating women ,crop failure, income loss, and livelihood distortion due to the loss of livestock. Moreover, there is a high prevalence of malnutrition among the population. The health and nutrition situation is particularly concerning, with women and children being disproportionately affected and vital health and nutrition facilities collapsed. This is coupled with drought and a weaker health service around these locations which has further exacerbated the situation, and putting the communities in increased life-threatening conditions. In Bidu the Global Acute Malnutrition (GAM) rate stands at 26.93 highlighting the severity of the nutritional crisis.ltbrgt ltbrgtThe water situation in Bidu is critical only with 7.5% coverage, as consecutive failed rains have affected all 15 kebeles, leading to displacement and disrupting essential infrastructure. lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtWV acknowledges the necessity of a collaborative multi-sector approach to address and reverse the current situation while also preventing any further deterioration. These efforts will be carried out in partnership with local implementing partner Friendship Support Association (FSA) ltbrgtAccordingly WV will implement comprehensive set of multi-sector interventions encompassing nutrition, Agriculture, WASH and health. These efforts aim to combat malnutrition, provide clean water sources, prevent disease spread, offer medical assistance for childhood illnesses and disease outbreaks, deploy mobile health and nutrition teams to reach communities daily and ensure protection mainstreaming through risk assessments and workshops.ltbrgt ltbrgtlt/pgt
